budget.metric: Absolute difference from independent reference values, with the test's 5e-13 absolute floor and 5e-12 relative allowance

reference.parameters: Bessel small and large arguments; modified Bessel domain and scale cases; incomplete and complete elliptic integrals including Pi; Jacobi quarter periods; Ei/E1 tails; convergent 2F1 parameter and argument fixtures
reference.license: Repository-authored generators and fixtures under MIT; mathematical reference material is cited from NIST DLMF
reference.regeneration: Run the generate_*_data.py tools referenced by each include header, then run the cited special-function test units

families.input_domain: Finite real or complex double dense matrices and regular real or complex matrix pencils in documented supported dimensions.

reference.method: Independently reconstructed Schur factorizations, known eigenvalue fixtures, orthogonality/unitarity checks, and normalized homogeneous generalized-eigenpair residuals

reference.precision: IEEE-754 binary64 real and complex arithmetic

reference.regeneration: Run TestDenseDecompositions; recompute the stated factor reconstructions and normalized homogeneous eigenpair residuals from the fixtures
